claim_boundary: PASS is limited to the eight declared synthetic revision-28 stop-classification scenarios and their pre-mutation rejection checks. It is not evidence of general recovery reliability, production capability, AGI, or user-level completion.
observations: The original classifier scanned serialized termination and refire-failure text for broad tokens, so legitimate hard-stop descriptions containing approval-like text could be mislabeled as discretionary.
The classifier now recognizes only five active, structurally corroborated legitimate stop categories and rejects incomplete legitimate-stop markers fail-closed.
Two discretionary scenarios, five legitimate non-discretionary scenarios, and one malformed hard-stop marker produced the exact expected classifications.
All eight unresolved-stop scenarios were rejected with the native snapshot byte-identical before and after WorkSession.resume.
The focused protected set passed 104 tests with zero failures.
